About the platform

Move from an idea to a working project.

CreatiCode builds on Scratch 3.0 so learners can create with blocks while exploring newer technologies without first mastering a complex programming language.

Students can design interactive stories, games, simulations, and AI-powered projects. Educator tools support classes, assignments, and guided learning experiences.

LearnersK–12 students and educators
FocusCreative coding and computational thinking
ToolsBlock coding, AI, 3D, and collaboration

What learners can do

Create, test, share, and remix.

Build with Blocks

Use a visual programming environment that makes complex ideas easier to explore.

Work with AI

Add speech, vision, chat, and other AI capabilities to original projects.

Design in 3D

Create interactive worlds and strengthen spatial reasoning through project-based work.
